svg.aria-label: Warm dimensional cutaway of a corner townhouse, with balcony and porch left, neighboring unit right, shared access lane above, landscaped edge below, and one garage downstairs
svg.metadata: Revision 8. The original second-floor room geometry and all control positions are unchanged. Balcony and covered porch are left; the entrance is inside. One single-car garage sits directly below this unit and is reached by the outdoor porch stairs; no garage is drawn on the second-floor plan or beside it. Exterior relationships: street frontage left, shared garage access lane above, attached neighbor continuing right, planted pedestrian edge below. The selected end-unit envelope forms a shallow dimensional frame. Image is an original stylized interpretation, not a survey. No addresses, street names, unit numbers, aerial raster or external assets are embedded. PNG is preferred for live display to avoid WebView SVG compositing artifacts; live motion belongs to dashboard overlays.
